name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) — Hard
description: Advanced RAG terminology as multi-word phrases, each totaling 16-20 letters.

words.hint: Fetching whole source files relevant to a query
Returning short evidence spans rather than full files
Enriching a prompt with fetched external information
Dense numeric encodings of text meaning
Finding items closest to a query in vector space
Chain from query to fetched supporting evidence
Pulling facts from an external store at query time
Ordering candidates by how well they fit the query
Anchoring generated answers in supplied evidence
Producing vector encodings from raw text
Model scoring query-passage pairs jointly for reordering
Rewriting a user request to improve retrieval
Merging multiple ordered lists by inverse position
